description: React component 'HabitCard' that displays a habit with toggle controls for the last 7 days, streak info, sparkline trend, and delete option. It uses hooks, external utility functions, and references external data client functions.

methods.name: HabitCard
methods.description: Main React component rendering a habit card with interactive toggles, streak info, sparkline, and delete button.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Handles toggling habit completion for a specific day, updating state, and triggering onChanged callback.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of the habit after user confirmation, updating state, and triggering onChanged callback.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if a given date string corresponds to today.
